status: exploratory Pass 42 prototype; no release claim

runtime.ssimulacra2_status: local Pass 39 configured executable absent; metric omitted
runtime.jpeg: Pillow JPEG encoder; RGB, subsampling=2, optimize=True
runtime.threading_note: All measured workers inherited the same environment; OpenBLAS pool is recorded.

boundary_taper.selection_note: diagnostic only; mode selection was performed for hard boundaries

gate_assessment.A_correctness: pass: six synthetic test groups and fresh-process exact-pixel checks across all measured streams
gate_assessment.B_quality_scaling: pass: all three V4-D curves reduce RGB MSE as bitrate increases; highest points approach lossless detail
gate_assessment.C_rate_distortion_vs_v31: fail as broad improvement: V4 improves fidelity at higher rates but does not preserve V3.1 low-rate behavior or show a comparable-rate general win
gate_assessment.D_speed_memory: fail for current implementation: coast V4-D intermediate ~34.15 s encode and ~11.83 s fresh-process decode; high points reach ~144–193 s encode. V3.1 is subsecond in these controls. A low-point memory profile peaked near 746 MiB.
gate_assessment.E_jpeg: mixed and mostly unfavorable: Googlewiki intermediate is a strong rate-matched win; cat low point is dominated by JPEG and detailed-photo refinement costs far more rate; coast JPEG q30 is close in quality at much lower rate than V4 intermediate.
gate_assessment.F_reserved_validation: not run: development evidence does not justify opening reserved images

caveats: Development set has three images and is not held out.
SSIMULACRA2 was omitted because the established local executable path is absent.
Pillow JPEG is pinned by the current runtime (Pillow 11.3.0); JPEG quality settings are compared by measured bytes and decoded MSE.
Fresh-process decode wall time includes Python startup and is not directly equivalent to V3.1 in-process timing; raw fresh-process V3.1 values are retained.
Boundary taper uses hard-selected modes and is diagnostic only; it is not a separately optimized codec point.
No AVIF re-encode or held-out validation was run.
